answer: The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. The design leans on time-locked work history, expired if not renewed by fresh work, idle agents bleed standing. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short. The plume lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the thread is where a second reviewer recomputes them. By the sonnet of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up.
